title: Spicy Filipino-Style Fish Cakes
description: A Thai-inspired twist on traditional Filipino fish cakes, with a spicy kick. Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the fish, Bicol Express Chili Sauce, Filipino-style Kissed Fish Sauce, Express Ground Black Pepper, and Spicy Fish Seasoning. Mix well until everything is fully incorporated.
2. In a separate bowl, beat the egg. Add the bread crumbs and mix until just combined.
3. Add the egg mixture to the fish mixture and mix until a dough forms.
4. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a patty.
5. Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
6. Add a small amount of oil to the skillet and cook the fish cakes for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
7. Remove the fish cakes from the skillet and place on a plate lined with paper towels to drain any excess oil.
8. Serve the fish cakes hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
